name: TasWiq · Lead-Automation (Funnel → Supabase → Discord → Mail → Follow-up)

parameters.content:
## TasWiq · Lead-Automation
1. **Header Auth** Credential: Name `x-taswiq-secret`, Wert = `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` aus `.env`
2. Production-URL dieses Webhooks → `N8N_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL`
3. Discord-Webhook-URL in beiden Discord-Nodes eintragen (Slack: Incoming Webhook, Body `{ text: ... }`)
4. SMTP + Supabase (Service-Role-Key) Credentials verbinden, `DEIN-PROJEKT` ersetzen
5. `SITE_URL` / `CALENDLY_URL` im Code-Node anpassen
